name: lightspec
description: Skills for the lightspec spec pipeline: draft a feature spec into specs/NNN-slug/spec.md in a script-enforced format, approve it on substance, and convert an accepted spec into a hew epic with one child issue per user story. ADR → spec → approve → tracker.

interface.shortDescription: Draft and approve feature specs, then file trackable work
